# TPC-Havoc Q2_v7

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
with cost_analysis as (
    select
        p_partkey,
        s_suppkey,
        s_acctbal,
        s_name,
        n_name,
        p_mfgr,
        s_address,
        s_phone,
        s_comment,
        ps_supplycost,
        min(ps_supplycost) filter (where r_name = 'EUROPE') over (partition by p_partkey) as min_cost
    from
        part,
        supplier,
        partsupp,
        nation,
        region
    where
        p_partkey = ps_partkey
        and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
        and p_size = 15
        and p_type like '%BRASS'
        and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
        and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
        and r_name = 'EUROPE'
)
select
    s_acctbal,
    s_name,
    n_name,
    p_partkey,
    p_mfgr,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    s_comment
from cost_analysis
where ps_supplycost = min_cost
order by
    s_acctbal desc,
    n_name,
    s_name,
    p_partkey
```
